harness: model-written Python is executed against each row's tests field. This is not the official SWE-bench or LiveCodeBench evaluation. This is not a kernel sandbox. The child runs only inside unshare (user, pid, and net namespace) from an environment that never held the keys. Inside that namespace, home and the workspace are covered with a tmpfs when that mount works. The opt-in path does not mount over the parent. If unshare is missing or the probe fails, model code is not run unless AUREON_BENCH_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED=1. That opt-in is unsandboxed: a same-user child can read /proc/PID/environ and can open a raw socket. Run this only on a machine with no secrets.
